title: Safety-First Voice Wellbeing Companion With Local RAG
tagline: Text-or-voice wellbeing companion answering from a licensed corpus with citations, behind a crisis gate.
pipeline: assess risk → check scope → retrieve (hybrid + RRF) → generate with citations → guard output → speak in the browser
note: Safety gate runs before retrieval; a crisis message never reaches the LLM

title: Field-Level Accuracy Of LLM References In Five Styles
tagline: Benchmark of per-field hallucination and omission when an LLM writes academic references.
pipeline: sample DOIs → build truth → generate → evaluate → report
note: Separates hallucination (false value) from omission (missing value) for each bibliographic field

title: Clinic Front Desk Assistant
tagline: Tool-calling clinic assistant that books, cancels and reschedules only after patient confirmation.
pipeline: sign-in → safety screen → model and tool calls → proposal → confirmation → atomic write
note: No tool takes a patient_id; identity comes from sign-in, and a red-flag screen runs before the model

title: Plain-English Requirements to Priced AWS and GCP Quotes
tagline: Turns a plain-English infrastructure requirement into side-by-side AWS and GCP cost quotes.
pipeline: extract → validate → match SKUs → price with units → verify → explain
note: The optional LLM only fills a validated schema; a deterministic matcher picks SKUs and a calculator prices them

title: Grounded Discharge Summaries With Checked Evaluation
tagline: Generates cited discharge summaries from coded EHR tables and scores them with rules and a separate judge.
pipeline: load tables → build de-identified records → generate summaries → check faithfulness → score with an independent judge → aggregate with intervals
note: Each summary statement cites record items; a rule check flags invented diagnoses, procedures and drugs

title: Guarded Text-to-SQL Device Recommendations
tagline: Text-to-SQL device recommender where code guards each generated query and checks every number in the summary.
pipeline: input check → slots and budget → generate SQL → SQL guard → run read-only → summary and faithfulness check
note: The LLM sees only two views, not base tables

title: Document-Grounded Graduate Advising Assistant
tagline: Graduate advising assistant that answers from an institution's own documents with citations, or abstains.
pipeline: load documents → split into token-sized chunks → sync the index → BM25 + vector search → fuse (RRF) → optional rerank → evidence check → prompt the chat model → validate citations
note: No evidence means no chat-model call; the abstention names a real advising contact

title: Learned Interior-Point Solver With A Seeded Attention Ablation
tagline: Learned Newton solvers for interior-point methods, compared in a seeded one-change-at-a-time ablation.
pipeline: generate → KKT system → learned Newton step → warm start → paired ablation
note: Five learned variants, each with one change against its parent, trained on several seeds with paired bootstrap intervals

title: Role-Aware Onboarding Assistant With Cited Answers
tagline: RAG assistant that answers a new data-team member's questions from team docs, filtered by role and level.
pipeline: load and split documents → build the index → filter by role and level → BM25 + vector search → fuse (RRF) → evidence check → prompt the chat model → validate citations
note: Refuses without calling the chat model when retrieval finds no evidence; citations validated against seen passages

title: Paper To Podcast Pipeline
tagline: Turns an arXiv paper into a multi-voice podcast WAV with a grounding and length quality report.
pipeline: fetch → parse → outline → script → validate → tts → mix
note: Lexical grounding check flags numbers and acronyms not found in the paper

title: Safe Multi-Source Insurance Questions and Answers
tagline: Routes insurance questions to SQL, MongoDB or policy-document RAG agents behind query validators.
pipeline: input check → route → generate query → validate → run read-only → answer with query or citations
note: Generated SQL checked by a sqlglot parser and Mongo pipelines by an allow-list; read-only executors

title: Retail Customer Service Assistant
tagline: Tool-using store assistant that scopes every data read to the signed-in customer and cites FAQ answers.
pipeline: sign-in → guardrails → model and tool requests → scoped read or FAQ retrieval → output checks
note: Staff SQL analytics checked by a SQLite authorizer over read-only views

title: A Reproducible Benchmark of Static Analyzers and LLM Code Reviewers
tagline: Benchmark comparing static analyzers and LLM code reviewers on a labelled Python corpus.
pipeline: validate corpus → run analyzers → store raw results → match to labels → score → triage and blind rating
note: One-to-one matching of findings to anchored labels; Wilson intervals on precision and recall

title: Phone-Level Pronunciation Feedback for English and Mandarin
tagline: Pronunciation coach that aligns recognised phones and Mandarin tones to the target and gives tips.
pipeline: canonical units → phone recogniser → alignment → error types → score → tips
note: Mandarin tone detection from pitch with tone-sandhi rules

title: Grounded Fact-Check Retrieval
tagline: Fact-checker that matches a political claim to PolitiFact and FactCheck.org articles or abstains.
pipeline: ingest → index → retrieve → rerank → match → judge → cite or abstain
note: Polite ingestion of PolitiFact and FactCheck.org feeds (robots.txt, per-host delay)

title: Used-Car Price Bands, Price Approval and Delivery-Time Bands
tagline: Calibrated price and delivery-time bands for a used-car marketplace, with an approve-or-review price rule.
pipeline: validate → split by time → fit quantile models → calibrate → evaluate against baselines → approve or review
note: Approval rule auto-approves only prices inside the band; all others go to a human reviewer

title: Election Sentiment, Fed Policy and Market Moves
tagline: Event-study and Granger-test pipeline asking whether 2024 election news and Fed decisions moved U.S. markets.
pipeline: load → align to trading days → score sentiment → event study → causality tests → walk-forward forecasts → report
note: Trading-day alignment with no interpolation of weekends, holidays or text-free days

title: Social-Bias Detection with a Saved Label Map and Two Honest Heads
tagline: Text classifier that flags social-bias generalisations and scores 10 bias categories independently.
pipeline: load sources → normalise categories → split by group → train two heads → tune thresholds → evaluate by source → predict
note: One taxonomy across CrowS-Pairs, IndiBias and SBIC, with the label map saved inside each model

title: Inequality Features for Bitcoin Return Forecasts
tagline: Walk-forward ablation testing whether Gini and Kolkata inequality features improve Bitcoin return forecasts.
pipeline: fetch → validate → compute features → walk-forward → compare with the random walk → report
note: Truncation test proves every feature at day t uses only data up to day t

title: Speaker-Attributed Transcripts for Earnings Calls
tagline: Diarization plus ASR pipeline that labels each word of a long earnings call with its speaker and scores it.
pipeline: decode → diarize → transcribe → align → export → score
note: CLI, evaluation and tuning all call the same CallPipeline.run, so scores describe the configured system

title: Leakage-Safe Blood-Cell Image Ensemble
tagline: Five-class blood-cell image classifier with duplicate-aware splits and out-of-fold stacking.
pipeline: index → dedupe → group split → out-of-fold stacking → single test pass → explain
note: Rotation- and flip-invariant perceptual hash finds augmented copies before the split

title: Leakage-Free Multi-Task Benchmark on NIH ChestX-ray14
tagline: Patient-split benchmark kit for comparing image backbones on the 14 NIH ChestX-ray14 finding labels.
pipeline: validate → split by patient → train → tune thresholds → evaluate → compare
note: Patient-wise split with the official NIH test list, checked in code

title: Leak-Free Telecom Churn Models with Ant Colony Feature Selection
tagline: Telecom churn models with ant-colony feature selection and a profit-based contact threshold.
pipeline: validate → split → engineer features → select (ACO) → fit and compare → pick threshold by profit → explain
note: All fitted steps, including the ACO selector and SMOTE, live in one scikit-learn pipeline

title: Mayo Endoscopic Score Grading With Honest Ablations
tagline: Grades ulcerative colitis colonoscopy images on the Mayo endoscopic subscore with patient-grouped folds.
pipeline: list all images → group folds by patient → RGB + optional contrast → grade (features or CNN) → QWK on held-out folds → test once → model card
note: Quadratic weighted kappa as the main metric, so far grade errors cost more than near ones

title: Crash Severity Models with Counterfactual Explanations
tagline: Crash-severity classifiers explained with permutation importance and actionable what-if counterfactuals.
pipeline: validate → split first → fit pipelines → evaluate on real rows → audit the signal → rank columns → generate counterfactuals
note: Synthetic generator with a known cause structure lets tests check that explanations find the true causes

title: Survey-Aware Injury Severity Analysis on NHTSA GES Crash Data
tagline: Survey-weighted injury-severity study of NHTSA GES crash data with crash-grouped model evaluation.
pipeline: validate → decode → build → weight → train → evaluate → report
note: GES codes decoded from a codebook file; sentinel codes never become numbers

title: Cross-Domain Recommendations from Food Tastes to Books and Back
tagline: Cold-start cross-domain recommender that suggests books from Amazon food ratings and food from book ratings.
pipeline: load → validate → filter shared users → split → fit → evaluate → recommend
note: CMF shares one user vector across domains; EMCDR learns a map between latent spaces

title: An Explainable Evidence Report on Stated Work Values
tagline: Recruiter review aid that matches a job's stated work values to a candidate's own words as quoted evidence.
pipeline: redact → extract value statements → align by category → evidence report → audit log → human decision
note: Personal data and protected-attribute cues are redacted before any step; an LLM needs explicit consent

title: Leakage-Aware Dementia Group Classification on OASIS-3
tagline: Classifies OASIS-3 visits into five dementia groups from MRI volumes with participant-level splits.
pipeline: validate → join visits to MRI → map dx text → select by grouped CV → evaluate once → predict
note: CDR scores, which define the diagnosis, appear only in a labelled leakage-ceiling feature set

title: A Leakage-Free ViT vs Hiera Benchmark for Skin-Lesion Classification
tagline: Lesion-grouped, multi-seed benchmark comparing ViT-B/16 and Hiera-Base on HAM10000 skin-lesion classes.
pipeline: validate metadata → split by lesion → train with class weights → reload best checkpoint → evaluate with balanced metrics → compare over seeds
note: Each backbone uses its own pretraining normalisation; only training images get augmentation

title: Trip-Level Driving Risk from Telematics and Location-Matched Context
tagline: Turns a raw telematics stream into trip rows and a per-driver risk index from harsh-event rates.
pipeline: ingest → segment trips → attach weather and roads → count harsh events → fit a rate model → score drivers
note: Target is harsh events from acceleration, and no feature reads the acceleration signals

title: EEG Biomarkers of Antidepressant (SSRI) Response
tagline: Subject-wise nested evaluation of whether resting-state EEG features predict SSRI treatment response.
pipeline: load → filter → epoch → extract features → nested subject-wise evaluation → report
note: Subject-grouped nested CV with scaling and selection fit inside each fold

title: Zero-Shot, Few-Shot And LoRA Language Models For Emotion Labels
tagline: Benchmark comparing baselines, zero-shot, few-shot and LoRA language models on 6-label emotion classification.
pipeline: load and check → prompt or fine-tune → score or decode → parse strictly → evaluate and compare
note: Strict parser with invalid answers counted as wrong, never dropped from the denominator

title: A Subject-Disjoint Benchmark for Engagement States in Face Video
tagline: Subject-disjoint benchmark that classifies face frames into 7 engagement states with a source-confound probe.
pipeline: build manifest → split by subject → preprocess (one function) → fit on train only → score the untouched test → aggregate clips → probe the source
note: One preprocessing function shared by training and inference

title: EV Adoption Diffusion And Review Sentiment
tagline: Forecasts yearly EV adoption with Bass and Generalized Bass models and measures owner-review sentiment.
pipeline: audit coverage → build the series → fit Bass and GBM → backtest against baselines → bootstrap the forecast → cross-validate sentiment → tag aspects
note: Rolling-origin backtest against naive, drift and other baselines; plain Bass loses to drift on the synthetic series

title: Federated Versus Centralized Diabetes Risk Models
tagline: Like-for-like benchmark of federated vs centralized training on BRFSS diabetes indicators.
pipeline: load and check → split → partition to clients → train centralized and federated → select on validation → compare over seeds
note: One configuration drives both settings, so only the location of the records differs

title: Indonesia Fire Hotspot Forecast Benchmark
tagline: Benchmark for 1- to 30-day forecasts of daily NASA FIRMS fire-hotspot counts in Indonesia.
pipeline: clean detections → build daily series → build windows → tune on a validation year → backtest and test
note: Detections filtered to vegetation fires; volcanoes, static sources and offshore points removed

title: Ingredient-Based Recipe Search With Grounded Explanations
tagline: Recipe recommender that ranks recipes for the ingredients you have and shows the real steps from the data.
pipeline: normalise → retrieve (overlap + dense) → score → filter → explain (grounded)
note: Hybrid retrieval: inverted ingredient index plus a dense PPMI+SVD embedding index

title: NFL Game Predictions with Leak-Free Features and Elo
tagline: Walk-forward NFL home-win probabilities from point-in-time features and pre-game Elo ratings.
pipeline: aggregate by game_id → point-in-time form → pre-game Elo → walk-forward by season → log-loss, Brier, calibration
note: Leakage test changes all results after a date and checks every earlier feature stays the same

title: Multi-Cohort Coronary Artery Disease Risk Models
tagline: Coronary artery disease risk models from three public cohorts with nested CV and leave-one-source-out.
pipeline: validate each source → harmonise and de-duplicate → split once → select with nested CV → test once → leave one source out → write the model card
note: Harmonises three cohorts with code books; zero cholesterol and blood pressure become missing

title: Liver And Tumor Segmentation With A Safe Patient Assistant
tagline: Liver and tumor CT segmentation scored per volume, plus a cited, non-diagnostic patient assistant.
pipeline: validate → preprocess → segment → measure → explain with citations
note: Strict checkpoint loading so the service never runs random weights; CT-only uploads that are not stored

title: Local Health Information Assistant With Cited Sources
tagline: Local health Q&A assistant that answers from your own labelled documents with a checked citation per sentence.
pipeline: safety triage → history-aware query → hybrid retrieval + relevance gate → generate (temperature ≤ 0.3) → check citations and doses
note: Emergency, self-harm, dosing and stop-medication questions get fixed replies before any retrieval

title: Hot-Food Demand Forecast And Order Planner
tagline: Forecasts daily hot-food demand by category and turns quantile forecasts into newsvendor orders.
pipeline: validate → build past-only features → backtest models → forecast quantiles → order (newsvendor)
note: A test changes all days after the origin and checks that no feature changes

title: Toxic Comment Detection with Guarded Polite Rewrites
tagline: Toxic-comment classifier for the 6 Jigsaw labels that offers guarded polite rewrites of flagged comments.
pipeline: classify → compare with the threshold → rewrite → guard → fall back → collect opt-in feedback
note: Evaluation at the natural toxic share with subgroup, BPSN and BNSP bias AUCs

title: Leakage-Safe Plant Disease Classification with Hybrid Features
tagline: Plant-disease leaf classifier with CNN plus handcrafted features, leaf-grouped splits and a field test.
pipeline: manifest → group split → cached features → select on val → score test once → score field set
note: Leaf ids and dihedral-invariant hashes keep copies of one leaf in one split; check_leakage stops a leaky split

title: Lung Nodule Malignancy Estimates With Multilingual Reports
tagline: Calibrated malignancy estimate for one marked lung nodule on CT, with a fixed-template report in 94 languages.
pipeline: validate → extract patch → estimate → calibrate → band → report → localize
note: Nodule labels from that nodule's readers; a guard stops the run if a patient crosses the split

title: Responsible Mental-Health Text Classification With Llama 3.1 QLoRA
tagline: Benchmarks classifiers of mental-health posts across 7 labels, with calibration and a crisis-routing rule.
pipeline: load → clean → remove duplicates → split → fit → calibrate → evaluate → route
note: MinHash near-duplicate groups kept on one side of the split to prevent leakage

title: Leakage-Safe Alzheimer's Risk Models
tagline: Tabular Alzheimer's risk models that separate risk-factor features from symptom features, with nested CV.
pipeline: validate → select → tune → calibrate → evaluate → report
note: Feature-set whitelists A/B/C separate cardiometabolic risk factors from symptom features

title: Cited Diet Plans For Chronic Conditions
tagline: Retrieval-grounded diet planner for diabetes, heart disease and thyroid disorders, with cited plans.
pipeline: register sources → chunk and index → screen symptoms → retrieve diet passages → validate the JSON plan → add foods from the food store → answer follow-up questions
note: JSON plan validated with pydantic schemas and retries with error feedback

title: Weather-Aware Paddy Leaf Disease Detection with an Honest Ablation
tagline: Rice leaf disease classifier that tests whether lagged local weather adds value to image models.
pipeline: validate → group fields and duplicates → lagged weather → train → evaluate once → compare variants
note: Image vs weather vs image+weather ablation over seeds with paired bootstrap CIs

title: Reproducible Benchmark for Paper Summarization, QA and RAG
tagline: Evaluation harness comparing paper summarizers and QA/RAG systems with confidence-interval leaderboards.
pipeline: load and sample → chunk → summarize or retrieve → answer → score → leaderboard
note: Number-consistency check keeps LLM-invented numbers visible

title: Pneumonia Detection With Honest Explanations
tagline: Chest X-ray pneumonia classifier with patient-aware splits and explanations independent of its prediction.
pipeline: patient split → train → select and calibrate on val → one test pass → neighbours + saliency → checked summary
note: Explanations from nearest neighbours and occlusion saliency with a randomisation sanity check

title: Explainable Professor Recommendations from Research Profiles and Teaching Signals
tagline: Recommends professors from research profiles and smoothed teaching ratings, with reasons for each result.
pipeline: validate query → candidates → text match → smoothed teaching signals → weighted score → reasons
note: Portal scraper with a terms check; raw scores hidden by default

title: Validated Sentiment, Aspect Sentiment and Topics for Reddit Policy Debates
tagline: Sentiment, aspect sentiment and topic pipeline for Reddit policy debates, validated against gold labels.
pipeline: collect → filter → two text views → sentiment → aspect sentiment → topics → validate → report
note: Separate model and topic text views so cleaning does not remove negations

title: Lab Report Explanations With Rules First
tagline: Explains lab report PDFs: rules flag abnormal values, then one LLM call writes a validated, cited explanation.
pipeline: extract → parse → flag → scrub → retrieve → explain → validate → chat
note: De-identification scrubber before any text leaves the machine; medicine-name filter on output

title: A Reproducible LLM Resume Benchmark
tagline: Benchmark harness that compares LLMs and prompt styles on resume writing with faithfulness-aware metrics.
pipeline: pair → render → generate → strip → score → resample → report
note: Grounded coverage gives no credit for skills the candidate profile does not have

title: River Water Quality, Weather Effects and the COVID Effect
tagline: Study toolkit for England river water quality: CCME index, weather effects and a COVID effect with intervals.
pipeline: ingest → convert units → link weather → index → model determinands → test COVID on a balanced panel

title: Accident Severity With Correct Live Weather And Honest Forecasts
tagline: Scores US accident severity with live OpenWeather data and backtests daily accident-count forecasts.
pipeline: validate → features → split by date → train + select on valid → test once → live score → rolling-origin forecast
note: Date-based split with preprocessing fit on train only; model selected on validation, test scored once

title: Honest Retail Sales Prediction for BigMart
tagline: Sales prediction for BigMart item-outlet data with CV that tests unseen outlets and unseen items.
pipeline: validate → engineer features → cross-validate by outlet and item → stack out-of-fold → explain → predict
note: Three CV schemes: random, new-outlet and new-item grouped folds

title: Multi-Sensory Furniture Recommender
tagline: Furniture recommender that fuses look, feel, text and sound features with modality attention.
pipeline: validate catalogue → temporal split → encode each sense → fuse with attention → rank and evaluate
note: Per-modality encoders with ablations that remove one sense at a time

title: A Fair Encoder By Head Sentiment Benchmark
tagline: Benchmark harness for three-class sentiment encoders and heads under one shared training protocol.
pipeline: load → clean → de-duplicate → split → train under one protocol → evaluate once → rank with paired tests
note: Protocol fingerprint ensures all leaderboard rows share split, length, optimizer and selection rule

title: A Validated Panel of Texas Public Library Statistics, 2018–2023
tagline: Builds a validated library-by-year panel from Texas library statistics to study the print-to-digital shift.
pipeline: ingest → link libraries → build the panel → total and check → backtest forecasts → fixed-effects regression → report
note: Links libraries across years without a stable ID using name, city and phone

title: Weather-Robust Traffic-Sign Recognition
tagline: Traffic-sign classifier with a weather-corruption robustness benchmark and a latency report.
pipeline: split by track → augment with weather → train → evaluate on corruption suites → detect and classify photos
note: Track-level split; leakage check shows random image split inflates accuracy

title: Station and NASA POWER Fusion for Hourly Temperature Forecasts
tagline: Fuses ground-station and NASA POWER data to forecast hourly temperature 1 to 24 hours ahead.
pipeline: load in UTC → check and fuse like-for-like → direct multi-horizon samples → baselines and models → skill and ablation
note: Aligns UTC station data with POWER local-standard-time data; target never averaged or filled

title: Point, Snap, Translate: An OCR Travel Translator
tagline: OCR translator for signs and menus that picks the OCR pack, detects language and routes to a backend.
pipeline: prepare image → OCR with the right pack → detect language → route to a backend → label the result
note: Script-range plus n-gram naive Bayes language detector

title: Subject-Routed Study Tutor With Cited Answers
tagline: Study tutor that routes text or voice questions by subject and answers from course material with citations.
pipeline: authenticate → route → retrieve → answer → check citations → record
note: LLM subject router with JSON schema and a centroid-router fallback

title: Hybrid Fashion Recommender With Honest Evaluation
tagline: Fashion recommender combining TF-IDF, BM25, dense and hybrid retrieval with an optional LLM re-ranker.
pipeline: parse the intent → filter the pool → retrieve (TF-IDF, BM25, dense, hybrid) → re-rank and validate IDs → give reasons → evaluate on labelled queries
note: Same candidate pool and filters for every system; LLM re-ranker can only return retrieved IDs

title: A Safety-First Symptom RAG Over Simulated Interviews
tagline: Symptom RAG over simulated doctor-patient interviews with red-flag triage and a medicine filter.
pipeline: transcribe → extract → index → triage → retrieve → answer → strip → evaluate
note: Case-record extraction (rule or LLM) from transcripts, with ASR WER/CER evaluation

title: Negation-Safe, Slang-Aware Tweet Sentiment
tagline: Tweet sentiment toolkit comparing lexicon, TF-IDF, hybrid neural and fine-tuned models on one shared split.
pipeline: normalize → de-duplicate → shared split → train → select on validation → evaluate once → predict
note: Held-out Gen-Z source tests generalisation; McNemar test between models

title: Video to Transcript, Summary and Thumbnail
tagline: Turns a spoken video into a transcript, summary, generated thumbnail and the best real frame.
pipeline: transcribe → summarize in chunks → write a visual prompt → generate · detect scenes → rank frames → evaluate
note: Map-reduce chunked summarization with extractive, BART or LLM summarizers

title: Diet Analytics And A Backend For A Talking VR Assistant
tagline: Country-level diet analytics, a personal diet guide and a key-safe backend for a VR nutrition assistant.
pipeline: load with unit checks → explore supply shares → analyze with controls → make a diet guide → answer in the VR client
note: Loader checks units so values read as shares of national supply, with sum checks

title: Brief Hospital Course Summarization Benchmark
tagline: Early-stage benchmark that prepares leakage-free MIMIC-IV note pairs for Brief Hospital Course summarization.
pipeline: load notes → remove BHC → join on note_id → split by patient → summarize (planned) → score (planned)
note: Removes the reference BHC section from the model input before any model sees the note

title: Food Delivery Time Prediction
tagline: Food delivery time regression with checked category maps, time and courier splits, and a model card.
pipeline: clean with checked category maps → add row-wise features → split by time or courier → fit one pipeline → tune with grouped folds → score by slice → predict the test file
note: Category maps reject unknown values so every traffic level, including Jam, reaches the model

title: Survey-Weighted Telemedicine Analysis of the NEHRS Physician Survey
tagline: Survey-weighted analysis kit for the NEHRS physician telemedicine survey with adjusted odds ratios.
pipeline: decode codes → apply the survey design → describe → compare tools → compare users with non-users → correct → report
note: Codebook decoder turns skip and missing codes into NaN and applies question universes

title: A Sound Before-And-After Study Of Sentiment And Moderation Talk
tagline: Before/after study pipeline for sentiment and moderation talk in posts around the Twitter-to-X change.
pipeline: load + anonymize → filter by rules → random equal samples → score sentiment → flag moderation talk → shared topics → statistics on counts
note: Chi-square on counts, Cramér's V and topic-standardised comparisons
